prompt: Under a concrete motorway flyover at night: a huge bonfire of pallets and broken furniture, hundreds of people in a wide ring around it, faces lit orange, the concrete pillars receding into darkness behind them with tents between every pillar. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
